submitted.rationale: Photocurrent rose steadily with V content: 3e-8 A at V=0.25 (idx 12), 1.1e-7 A at V=0.34 (idx 13), 2.4e-7 A at V=0.52 (idx 10). XRD on idx 13, 8, 11 and 5 (V=0.34 to 0.475) showed the same phase pattern throughout, so there is no phase boundary in that range and the trend should continue. Idx 10 is the most V-rich candidate in the library, near AgVO3 stoichiometry, and has the highest measured photocurrent.

rejected.reason: Measured 3e-8 A, lowest of the three. Near Ag3VO4 composition.
Same XRD phase as 13, 8 and 11, and its composition lies between them and idx 10 on the increasing trend, so it was not measured.
Photocurrent falls as Ag increases; not measured.
